title: Staged quality-gate PRD for generation + embedding endpoint suite and go-live checklist
creator: Priya Nair
description: High-level PRD to define acceptance gates, quality metrics, and staged launch plan for a unified hosted endpoint suite covering chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank. Focus is on progressive rollout with automated quality gates (ML and infra signals), clear rollback criteria, and operator runbooks. This ticket captures requirements, non-functional targets, and a prescriptive go/no-go checklist for canary -> regional -> global rollout.
scope: Define behavioral and perf acceptance criteria for chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank endpoints
Specify staged rollout phases (canary, regional, broad) and gating signals per phase
Document test harnesses and evaluation datasets for quality regression detection
List operational runbooks, rollback steps, and monitoring dashboards required for launch
Coordinate SDK and docs updates necessary for public launch
out_of_scope: Dedicated customer-reserved capacity configuration (handled by Dedicated product tickets)
Private/VPC on-prem packaging and install automation
Model selection / training work beyond selecting verified model variants
requirements: Functional: Single API surface must accept 'mode' parameter to select chat, completion, embedding, or rerank behaviour
Functional: Endpoints return consistent structured metadata: model_version, token_usage, latency_ms, deterministic_id for rerank results
Functional: Streaming should be supported for chat and completions with identical SDK/REST shape
Quality: Define baseline quality metrics per endpoint and dataset (e.g., ROUGE-like or human eval buckets for chat/completions; cosine AUC for embeddings; pairwise NDCG for rerank)
Reliability: Per-route 99th p95/p99 latency SLO goals: chat 150ms p50 / 500ms p99 for short responses; completions p50 80ms per token, p99 within 1200ms for typical sequences
Cost: Provide default quantization/variant mapping to target 30% lower token cost vs previous fleet for comparable latency
Observability: Telemetry must include token-level cost, inference kernel selection, KV cache hit rate, batch size distribution
Rollout: Must support policy-driven routing with graded fallback to cheaper model variants when quality delta < threshold
Security & Compliance: Audit logs enabled for all production requests for 90 days; ensure KMS integration for any key material used in private deployments
acceptance_criteria: Unit & integration tests: all endpoint behaviors covered in CI and passing for 7 consecutive runs
Perf: Canary traffic (1% of production) achieves no more than 5% latency regressions vs baseline and token cost within target band for 48h
Quality: Automated eval harness shows no statistically significant drop in quality on held-out prompts (alpha=0.05) for all four modes
Stability: No outage/severe error rate spike (>0.5% 5xx) observed during 72h canary
Telemetry: Console dashboards populate with per-route token cost, latency percentiles, and top-10 prompt regression alerts prior to regional rollout
Rollback: Fully automated rollback (traffic-shift back to prior model/provider) validated in staging and exercised in one dry-run
Docs & SDK: Public SDKs updated with examples for each mode and streaming behavior; changelog entry drafted and reviewed
Security: Security review completed and any recommendations tracked with remediation tickets; audit logging and KMS config validated
launch_checklist: Pre-launch: Lock API contract and publish API schema to registry
Pre-launch: Upload evaluation datasets (chat prompts, completion prompts, embedding pairs, rerank triples) to eval bucket and set access controls
Pre-launch: Run full eval harness and store results; share report with stakeholders
Canary Phase: Open canary to internal traffic + 1% production traffic for 72 hours
Canary Phase: Monitor quality gates (auto alerts for A/B metric deviations) and infra gates (p99 latency, CPU/GPU saturation)
Canary Phase: Execute rollback dry-run and validate playbook within production staging window
Regional Phase: Expand to 3 regions with 10% traffic slice each; verify routing and cache priming
Regional Phase: Confirm telemetry ingestion latency <= 1m and backfills for sampled requests
Pre-global: Documentation, SDK release, and deprecation notes for legacy endpoints completed
Global Phase: Gradually ramp to 100% with automated checks enforcing quality and latency gates
Post-launch: Run 14-day quality regression sweep and freeze significant model/config changes for 7 days
Post-launch: Schedule follow-up retrospective and produce a 'launch health' dashboard for PM/Eng/DS review
